title: AI page opens on a dashboard

chat.text: The owner: /framework/ai/ is "still the inbox that is horribly broken"; it should open on a dashboard of what matters most, with a place to say something. First: list what is broken, with numbers. Then: one dashboard built small (say something, waiting on you and ready to merge, the big things now, what is running, the queue's top 3, usage), with the sessions list one click down.
